criteria: 30 structured interviews; at least 15 credible prospective authors or reviewers; competitor and title collision check; written narrow scope.
evidence_required: Interview register; anonymised synthesis; title search record; approved scope.
conflicts: Interviewees must not be promised publication or editorial roles.
stop_rule: Continue publishing methods or policy notes only if demand is not demonstrated.

criteria: Independent Editor-in-Chief accepts; at least eight active editors from four South Asian countries; signed roles recusals appeals and removal rules.
evidence_required: Acceptance letters; board matrix; signed governance and conflict records.
conflicts: Founder cannot simultaneously control publishing acceptance appeals ethics and commercial sponsorship.
stop_rule: Do not solicit manuscripts without an independent EIC and complete signed governance.

criteria: Test submission and review platform; author and reviewer checklists; complete ethics peer-review AI data conflicts correction retraction complaint fee copyright privacy and preservation policies.
evidence_required: Test records; policy pack; access controls; workflow rehearsal report.
conflicts: Consulting CRM and editorial records must remain separate.
stop_rule: Pilot internally; do not open public submissions if any mandatory policy or role is missing.

criteria: Four Evidence Notes issued on schedule; 20 reviews completed; workflow metrics available; DOI and archiving path tested; no unresolved ethics event.
evidence_required: Published notes; review log; public metrics; DOI metadata tests; preservation evidence; incident register.
conflicts: Paid consulting must not influence selection review or authorship.
stop_rule: Delay a journal and continue the note series if the schedule quality or independence evidence is insufficient.

criteria: Legal title and ownership checked; board active; ISSN process understood; two-issue pipeline; annual budget funded; preservation plan operational.
evidence_required: Legal/title check; board activity record; current official ISSN requirements; accepted pipeline; approved budget; preservation agreement.
conflicts: No indexing timeline or prestige claim may be used to recruit authors.
stop_rule: Remain a review series until every criterion is evidenced.

criteria: Current requirements for each target service checked from primary sources after a stable publication record; metadata policies and publication history complete.
evidence_required: Dated source crosswalk for each index; publication record; machine-readable metadata and policy audit.
conflicts: Application decisions belong to indexes and cannot be promised or sold.
stop_rule: Do not announce application acceptance probability or target dates.
